title: Insufficient logging and monitoring detection: verify security events are logged and error handling doesn't leak information
goal: WebGoat has a dedicated logging module. OWASP A09:2021 - Security Logging and Monitoring Failures. No current runner tests this. Implement a logging-probe runner: (1) Error leakage detection: send malformed requests (invalid JSON, SQL syntax errors, stack trace triggers) and check if responses contain: stack traces, internal file paths, database error messages, framework version info, internal IP addresses. Finding: 'Error Information Disclosure - Stack Trace/Internal Path Exposed'. (2) Admin panel exposure: check common admin paths (/admin, /management, /actuator, /debug, /console, /phpinfo.php, /server-status). Spring Actuator endpoints (/actuator/env, /actuator/heapdump, /actuator/mappings) are particularly dangerous. (3) Exposed debug endpoints: check for /_debug, /debug/vars (Go), /debug/pprof, /.env, /config.json, /config.yml exposed at root. (4) Log injection probe: inject CRLF sequences (\r\n) and log format strings (%s, %n, ${jndi:...} — Log4Shell variant) into parameters. Check if application echoes them back unsanitized. Finding: 'Log Injection Possible' or 'Log4Shell-Style Injection Pattern Accepted'. (5) Verbose error mode: systematically trigger common errors (404, 500, auth failure) and document what information each reveals. Passive + active tier.
scope: WebGoat logging module + OWASP A09. Not currently tested. Information leakage via error messages and admin panel exposure are consistently found in enterprise pentests.
generation_reason: OWASP A09 (Logging/Monitoring Failures) not tested — WebGoat has dedicated module, stack traces and Spring Actuator exposure are common enterprise findings.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Error and path probing only. JNDI probe: inject ${jndi:ldap://callback/a} as a detection-only string to check if Log4Shell-vulnerable apps attempt callbacks. Never chain to actual JNDI exploitation.
constraints.safety: Log4Shell probe uses OOB callback detection only, NOT actual exploitation.

success_criteria: Stack trace exposure detected via malformed requests.
Spring Actuator endpoints detected when exposed.
Common admin/debug path exposure produces findings.
Log injection probe tests CRLF and log format strings.
Passive tier for error analysis, active for path probing.
